description: Download a CSV or JSON asset from data.geo.admin.ch (href from get_geodata_collection_items) and return it as rows you can filter, sort and page, e.g. MeteoSwiss SwissMetNet station files. Filters: where={column: value} (exact), '~text' (substring), '>n'/'<n' (numeric). tail=true returns the latest rows of a time series. Example: url='https://data.geo.admin.ch/ch.meteoschweiz.ogd-smn/ber/ogd-smn_ber_d_recent.csv', tail=true, limit=7, columns=['reference_timestamp','tre200d0','rre150d0']. Large historical files may exceed max_mb, prefer '_recent' or '_now' files.

max_mb.description: Download size cap in MB (default 8, max 20)

offset.description: Skip this many matching rows (ignored with tail)

search.description: Case-insensitive text search across all columns

tail.description: Return the LAST matching rows (latest values of a time series)

url.description: Asset href on https://data.geo.admin.ch/ (CSV, TXT or JSON/GeoJSON)

name: read_geodata_asset
title: Read and query a CSV/JSON data file from data.geo.admin.ch
